messages:
Maria Lopez: Quick FYI — noticed runtime guide has a 404 on the 'model-onboarding' anchor. Hit from the onboarding flow and broke QA tests.

Lee Chen: Where's the link? paste the URL?

Maria Lopez: /docs/runtime/onboarding#model-onboarding -> returns 404 in staging. Also the curl snippet references /v1/models/list which is deprecated.

docs-bot: link-scan: found 1 broken internal anchor in /docs/runtime/onboarding (scan id 2026-03-18-4571). See <https://internal.tools/scan/2026-03-18-4571>

Samir Patel: I can take a quick PR. Does the anchor need renaming or the page moved?

Anita Gomez: Anchor was renamed during the structure cleanup last week. Quick fix is to update the anchor in the linking page to #onboarding-models. Also update the curl snippet to `curl https://api.redwood.ai/v2/models`.

Samir Patel: Working on it now — will put up a tiny PR with two edits: link change + snippet swap. Assigning to @Lee for review.

Samir Patel: PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3221 (tiny: runtime onboarding link + snippet)

Lee Chen: Reviewing now.

Lee Chen: left one tiny nits comment re: backticks, but good to merge once CI passes.

Samir Patel: Merged. (CI green)

Maria Lopez: Verified staging link works and QA tests pass. Thanks :party_parrot: 

Lee Chen: Nice. Adding follow-up to backlog: add redirect for old anchor in case any external links exist.

Anita Gomez: Pinged platform-team to add short redirect rule for the old anchor, created ticket INF-907.

docs-bot: resolved link-scan 2026-03-18-4571 (+ :white_check_mark: by Samir Patel)

Maria Lopez: closing thread. Thanks everyone!
